boarding_points.name: Puerto Juárez Maritime Terminal
boarding_points.notes: Primary Cancún ferry terminal for the Isla Mujeres crossing; ~20-min crossing, high-frequency Ultramar service.

boarding_points.name: Gran Puerto Cancún
boarding_points.notes: Modern Ultramar passenger terminal adjacent to Puerto Juárez serving Isla Mujeres.

boarding_points.name: Punta Sam Terminal
boarding_points.notes: Vehicle + passenger ferry terminal north of Puerto Juárez to Isla Mujeres; limited daily schedule.

boarding_points.name: Playa Tortugas (Zona Hotelera)
boarding_points.notes: Hotel-zone embarkation pier used for Isla Mujeres day service; hotel-zone mesh node.

boarding_points.name: Isla Mujeres Passenger Dock
boarding_points.notes: Island-side terminal for all Cancún crossings; APIQROO-administered.
